Our continued growth requires leaders who operate both strategically and tactically; think big to drive new opportunities; dive deep in data to uncover customer insights; and break down and solve complex problems. Kindle is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own engagement marketing strategy for Kindle devices like Paperwhite, Colorsoft, and Scribe. Using customer insights and data-driven decision making, you will help shape how customers discover, adopt, and stay engaged with Kindle reading and writing experiences. This role is inherently cross-functional; you will work closely with Product Management, Analytics, Go-to-Market, Finance, and our international teams to bring your strategy to life, and ultimately delight Kindle customers. If you're passionate about the future of reading and writing and working on products that become an essential part of people's daily lives, this role offers you the chance to make a lasting impact on how people engage with the written word in the digital age. About the team This role sits within the Kindle Software Product Management team that owns the customer facing software experiences across all Kindle devices and apps - ranging from how you read, write, navigate, acquire content and more. We believe reading is essential for a healthy society; our mission is to be the world's favorite place to read, write and get more out of reading.
